notes:
Summary:
- Internal engineering-first buyer: platform for enterprise code search + documentation RAG. Primary users: developer tooling teams and security/compliance.
- Corpus: ~120M segments (code blocks + doc paragraphs). Active repo updates -> near-daily incremental re-indexing (~10-15% churn/day).
- Requirements: low tail latency for search + rerank, fast re-index cycles, predictable unit economics. P99 target for combined vector fetch + neural rerank <= 200ms for developer workflows; median interactive target <80ms. Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.005/query average at scale.
- Model preferences: open/quantized variants acceptable (Llama2-family 13B/70B quantized), but will evaluate Redwood-verified perf profiles. Must support hybrid reranking: cheap ANN top-200 fetch then neural rerank for top-10.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated with VPC initially; contingency for on-prem appliance for sensitive repos. SSO/SAML + SCIM mandatory; audit logs and KMS for key management; EU data residency for EMEA teams.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable P99s — engineers will abandon search if results take >250ms. Also cannot have re-indexing windows that block commits."
- POC plan agreed: pilot on 2M most-active code/doc segments -> measure recall/latency/cost -> scale to 50M performance run (runbook by Redwood SE) -> prod roll to 120M with canary routing.
- Integrations: GitHub webhooks for incremental updates, internal ETL to split code into semantic chunks, existing vector DB proof-of-concept (self-hosted FAISS) but limited on multimodal and rerank throughput. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations on batching/caching and quantization profiles.
- Risks: procurement timeline for on-prem hardware (security requires air-gapped option for one business unit), IdP team bandwidth for SCIM.
- Artifacts: pricing deck and security FAQ shared (drive links), two discovery calls recorded (fireflies).
- Sales note: AE to push Dedicated pricing + 90-day scale discount; highlight Redwood fallback and model routing to keep latency during load spikes.
